The '''Circlet of Saresh''' was a headband owned by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Guun Han Saresh]]. The [[Saresh family]] were natives of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], but in the past they were known for their arrogance and cruelty as much as their immense wealth and political influence. As such, when Guun Han's [[Guun Han Saresh's father|father]] commissioned the Circlet as a gift marking the young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek's]] entry into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], he made sure that it was crafted in such a way as to make it usable only by a servant of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

The Circlet boosted its wearer's [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It was lost when Guun Han was devoured by a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] during the his [[Cleansing of Kashyyyk|attempt to kill]] the creature during the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]]. Revan later recovered the Circlet and may have worn it at some point during his quest for the [[Star Forge]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. It is also possible that five years later, [[Meetra Surik]] may have come across the Circlet and used it during the [[First Jedi Purge]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''<ref name="KOTOR" /> and <ref name="KOTOR 2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> the Circlet of Saresh is an equippable headband that provides a +5 bonus to the character's Wisdom attribute.<ref name="KOTOR" /><ref name="KOTOR 2" />
